Keep Local Product Intent—Add Choice Privileges: retain MainStay Suites's brand promise while accessing loyalty earn/redeem and parent commercial systems a standalone hotel cannot buy alone.
Affordable extended-stay: suites with kitchenettes and Choice Privileges for longer-stay value demand in midscale extended-stay.

Operator & Owner Fit: strongest when the asset can deliver the brand's guest promise with QA discipline—weakest when sponsors want the flag without the product investment.
